crossRefs.note: It came to pass, when they had taken them out, that he said, “Escape for your life! Don’t look behind you, and don’t…
Boiling over like water, you shall not excel; because you went up to your father’s bed, then defiled it. He went up to…
Why do you go about so much to change your ways? You will be ashamed of Egypt also, as you were ashamed of Assyria.
You will also leave that place with your hands on your head; for Yahweh has rejected those in whom you trust, and you…
He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
Lot lifted up his eyes, and saw all the plain of the Jordan, that it was well-watered everywhere, before Yahweh…
Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I have lifted up my hand to Yahweh, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,
and the south, and the Plain of the valley of Jericho the city of palm trees, to Zoar.
My heart cries out for Moab! Her nobles flee to Zoar, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for they go up by the ascent of Luhith…
From the cry of Heshbon even to Elealeh, even to Jahaz they have uttered their voice, from Zoar even to Horonaim, to…

people.name: Lot
people.line: Abraham's nephew; rescued from Sodom's destruction

people.name: Zoar
people.line: A city near Sodom, spared from destruction

translations.web: Lot went up out of Zoar, and lived in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he was afraid to live in Zoar. He lived in a cave with his two daughters.
translations.bsb: Lot and his two daughters left Zoar and settled in the mountains—for he was afraid to stay in Zoar—where they lived in a cave.
translations.kjv: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.
translations.asv: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.
